primitives.name: Data Routing Service
primitives.verbatim_quote: A data routing service 80 is provided for data movement from one server to another based on pre-defined routing rules In one embodiment, data routing rules may be defined in XML property files.
primitives.assumptions: Routing rules are deterministic and pre-defined; data movement occurs between discrete servers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when routing rules are malformed or server connectivity is disrupted.

layer2.mapping: The XML property file defines a structured rule set that mirrors the logical structure of GSI's Bayesian belief networks, where each rule corresponds to a conditional probability distribution over data paths.
layer2.telemetry: Routing success rate and latency per rule execution.

primitives.verbatim_quote: A data integration service 84 is provided to resolve heterogeneous/inconsistent data sources.

primitives.breakdown_regime: Integration fails when semantic mismatches exceed tolerance thresholds.

primitives.assumptions: Agents operate autonomously within defined organizational hierarchies and can perceive environmental changes.
